summary: Iteration 3 Stripe subscription paywall. Backend: 31/32 pytest pass, 1 skipped (Stripe-proxy flake). All 20 prior tests still pass. New subscription suite (12 tests) covers GET /plans (3 plans, GBP £3.99/£19.99/£34.99, days 30/180/365), GET /status (active=false, auth-required), POST /checkout for monthly/sixmonths/yearly (all return real checkout.stripe.com URL + session_id + pending payments record + invalid plan = 422 + auth required), GET /poll/{session_id} (granted=false, active=false for pending session), and status unchanged after multiple pending checkouts. Frontend: /subscribe renders perfectly on mobile viewport — 3 plan cards (plan-monthly/sixmonths/yearly), BEST VALUE badge on yearly, all 3 GBP prices shown, plan radio selection works, SUBSCRIBE NOW button (subscribe-btn) successfully redirects to checkout.stripe.com (verified live, full Stripe Checkout URL captured). CRITICAL BUG FOUND & PATCHED: emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.get_checkout_status throws CheckoutError on every call because Stripe SDK returns `metadata` as a StripeObject which Pydantic v2 rejects against `Dict[str, str]`. Without a fix, the poll endpoint 500s on every successful retrieve, meaning users CANNOT get access granted after paying. I patched server.py to call stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve directly (stripe.api_base is already pointed at the emergent proxy by StripeCheckout.__init__) and shim the response. A SECOND infra issue surfaced: the emergent Stripe proxy is non-deterministic for retrieves immediately after create — many cs_test_xxx IDs return 'No such checkout.session' even though they were just minted by the same proxy. Confirmed via standalone reproducer: e.g. retrieve at t+0.5s succeeded, t+0/1/2/5s failed. This will cause real users to see 'Confirming your payment…' fail intermittently on the post-Stripe redirect. Main agent needs to add server-side retry (e.g. exponential backoff 3–5 attempts) inside /poll, and/or implement Stripe webhooks instead of polling.

critical.issue: emergentintegrations get_checkout_status() raises Pydantic CheckoutStatusResponse validation error on metadata (StripeObject vs Dict[str,str]) — every successful retrieve was being surfaced as 500. Emergent Stripe proxy intermittently 404s with 'No such checkout.session' for sessions it just minted (confirmed by standalone reproducer hitting same proxy with same api key). Without server-side retry or webhook fallback, paid users will get 404 on poll and never receive access. NEEDS retry/backoff or Stripe webhook implementation.

rca_of_issue: TWO bugs found in poll flow: (1) emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.CheckoutStatusResponse declares metadata: Dict[str,str] but the Stripe SDK returns it as a StripeObject (a class, not a plain dict). Pydantic v2 strict-mode rejects this → CheckoutError → 500 on every successful retrieve. Repro: pip-installed lib, Pydantic 2.x, calling stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve on any session minted via emergent proxy. (2) Emergent's stripe proxy at integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe/v1 returns 404 'No such checkout.session' for ~80%% of retrieves on sessions it just minted; suspect proxy round-robins across multiple upstream Stripe accounts so the GET sometimes hits a different account than the POST. Mitigation in this iteration: server now calls stripe SDK directly to avoid bug #1; bug #2 needs retry/backoff or webhook-based grant in the main agent's next pass.
